autopull.notes: GitHub Pages cannot reliably fetch/scrape itch.io pages client-side because of CORS, so live account refresh happens at build time and writes all_items.json/docs/data/all_items.json. The browser then no-cache fetches the JSON like the rest of the HUB manifests.
autopull.mediaPolicy: Prefer animated GIF/media when itch exposes it; otherwise use cover image; otherwise render a deterministic SVG fallback.
